title: Probabilistic adjustment of seasonal forecasts using cVAE with a non-parametric decoder: A case study of Arctic sea ice predictions
abstract: arXiv:2605.29172v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Seasonal climate predictions support planning and risk management by offering early information of the likely climate conditions in the coming months, and associated uncertainties. Ensemble forecasts enable this by simulating many plausible outcomes, allowing predictions to be expressed as usable probabilities. Large ensembles and high-resolution forecasts strengthen this by better sampling uncertainty and capturing finer-scale processes but come with significant computational cost. Moreover, forecast ensembles drift and exhibit systematic biases and spatio-temporal errors that grow with lead time, requiring careful post-processing and calibration. A probabilistic post-processing framework based on conditional Variational Autoencoders (cVAEs) was developed at the Canadian Center for Climate Modeling and Analysis to generate large ensembles of adjusted seasonal predictions of Arctic sea ice. translated_title: 使用带非参数解码器的条件变分自编码器对季节预报进行概率调整：以北极海冰预测为例的案例研究
translated_abstract: 季节气候预报通过提供未来几个月可能出现的气候状况及其相关不确定性的早期信息，为规划和风险管理提供支持。集合预报通过模拟多种可能的结果来实现这一目标，使预报能够以可用的概率形式表达。大集合和高分辨率预报通过更好地采样不确定性和捕捉更精细尺度的过程来增强这一能力，但伴随着巨大的计算成本。此外，预报集合会发生漂移，并表现出随预报时效增长而增大的系统性偏差和时空误差，因此需要细致的后处理和校准。加拿大气候建模与分析中心开发了一个基于条件变分自编码器（cVAE）的概率后处理框架，用于生成大量经过调整的北极海冰季节预报集合。该生成模型旨在学习……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 加拿大气候建模与分析中心开发了一种基于条件变分自编码器（cVAE）的概率后处理框架，能够以较低计算成本生成大量经过偏差调整的北极海冰季节预报集合。
en_tdlr: A probabilistic post-processing framework based on conditional Variational Autoencoders (cVAEs) was developed to efficiently generate large ensembles of bias-adjusted seasonal forecasts of Arctic sea ice.
